claim: Our packaging is made from 100% recycled materials.
example_evidence_request: Request supplier material composition and certification.

claim: Every delivery we make is carbon neutral.
example_evidence_request: Request lifecycle boundary and offset records.

claim: All our ingredients are ethically sourced.
example_evidence_request: Request supplier audits and a definition of ethical.

claim: 100% of customer support conversations are handled by AI with no human involvement.
example_evidence_request: Request escalation logs and intervention rates.

claim: Selected Apple Watch Series 9 configurations are carbon neutral.
example_evidence_request: Verify model and band configuration.

claim: The affected diesel vehicles meet emissions requirements in normal driving.
example_evidence_request: Request regulator documents and precise model years.

claim: Our new pouch is completely biodegradable.
example_evidence_request: Request breakdown conditions and test standards.

claim: Our production process generates zero emissions.
example_evidence_request: Request measured scopes and process inventories.

claim: Our process uses 35 percent less water than our previous process.
example_evidence_request: Request baseline period and metering methodology.

claim: Our battery charges twice as fast as competing products.
example_evidence_request: Request matched benchmark methodology.

claim: Our herbal drink prevents all colds.
example_evidence_request: Request controlled studies and medical review.

claim: Every person in our supply chain receives a living wage.
example_evidence_request: Request wage records and supplier coverage.

claim: Users in a pilot reported higher satisfaction.
example_evidence_request: Request sample size and study design.

claim: 81% of survey participants preferred the new design.
example_evidence_request: Request survey methodology and sample.

claim: Our offices run on 100% renewable electricity.
example_evidence_request: Request utility statements and certificate matching.

claim: Our bottle is plastic-free.
example_evidence_request: Request cap and liner composition.

claim: We have audited every supplier this year.
example_evidence_request: Request audit register and supplier inventory.

claim: Our company will reach net zero emissions by 2030.
example_evidence_request: Request transition plan and scope definitions.

claim: Our AI tool is 99.9 percent accurate.
example_evidence_request: Request test set, metric, and confidence intervals.

claim: Our platform never stores customer data.
example_evidence_request: Request data flow mapping and retention policy.

claim: Ten percent of profits are donated to education.
example_evidence_request: Request accounting definition and donation receipts.

claim: The container can be reused 50 times.
example_evidence_request: Request durability test protocol.

claim: The bottle contains some post-consumer recycled resin.
example_evidence_request: Request composition evidence without inferring percentage.

claim: All of our produce is locally sourced.
example_evidence_request: Request distance definition and procurement records.
